newsitem.title: FRANCE: Euro-commission rejects Catalan's suit against Spain.
newsitem.headline: Euro-commission rejects Catalan's suit against Spain.

text.p: The European Commission of Human Rights rejected on Thursday as non-admissible a suit brought against Spain by a Catalan nationalist alleging ill treatment in Spanish jails.

The Commission, which screens cases for the European Court of Human Rights, agreed with the Spanish government's defence that Ramon Pique Huertas had not pursued all legal recourse in Spain before bringing his suit to Strasbourg.

It also said medical certificates submitted by Pique did not corroborate his charge that he suffered ill treatment after being arrested in Barcelona during a demonstration by local Catalan nationalists on the eve of the opening of the Olympic Games there in 1992.
Pique was sentenced in 1995 to five years imprisonment for membership of an armed group but was released the following year.
